displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 45 is 4 short and 5 long
meaning: Control circuitry lockout. The control auto-resets after a 1-hour lockout caused by a flame-sense circuit failure, a gas-valve relay stuck open, or a software check error. Reset power to clear the lockout. Replace the control if the code repeats.
diySteps: Count 4 short flashes and 5 long flashes. The 1-hour reset is not a repair
Technician: reset power once to clear the lockout. If 45 returns, replace the furnace control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 45 returns after one power reset. Do not keep resetting it overnight.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
